title: Isekai Parlor ~The Story of a Former Salaryman Who Accidentally Builds a Harem With the Overpowered Cheat Skill “Aesthe” and Rises to Become an Emperor of the Underworld~
description:
A cheat skill called "Aesthe" melts women into bliss!

Sousuke, a salaryman in his thirties who is suddenly transported to another world, receives a cheat ability as his transfer bonus—the "Aesthe" skill. The moment he begins massaging someone with it, everything changes.

"...Ahh..."
"Ahhhhnn!"
The women let out soft, involuntary moans as his hands work over them.

By the time the massage is over, they become completely undone.
"I... I can no longer live without Sousuke-san's massages anymore..."
They say, utterly "taken" by his touch.

As he continues massaging women, Sousuke somehow finds himself rising through the ranks, eventually becoming an emperor who dominates the underworld of another land!
author: Fukuju Soushin
